items.title: Paul Shaffer interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 24, 2023
items.q: Our long-time, as you know, long bassist on Letterman from start to finish but even before that you know he was a top studio guy.

ctx.x: Our long-time, as you know, long bassist on Letterman from start to finish but even before that you know he was a top studio guy. And during — there was a period of time I guess in the ‘90s where some records came out called “TV Tunes,” versions of the great TV themes and stuff that you could buy on a vinyl record. This was in the days of vinyl, and you could get whether it was the Flintstones theme or the different themes to classic shows. And when they could afford it I think they used the originals but…
I knew it a little bit, but I just, and nobody would get this kind of treatment in the studio but I was on television and a little bit I could ask. I just said to the guy [inaudible]
